transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster (surface line y=299.5, 0 cm y=2751.5, 23.13 px/cm); boundaries printed on the right axis and every bar edge agrees with them. Hardness from bar left edges vs gridlines (I/K/P/1F/4F/F at 707/967/1227/1487/1747/2007 px, 260 px per class; thirds as +/-). Temperatures are break points of the unmarked red polyline (Douglas-Peucker on the line centre, +-0.1 C / +-0.5 cm), calibrated with x = 2115.5 + 46.80*T(C). Dashed air-temperature segment rises from the surface toward the printed -2.0 C (not a snow temperature). Red highlight lines (pure red) sit next to the dashed leaders: at 103 cm just below the boundary spanning the F bar of the layer below, at 78 cm just above the boundary spanning the 4F bar of the layer above; each layer whose bar edge the line touches gets 'highlighted red'. Water content column blank for all layers; no density column.
